items.title: Along an effective Cartier divisor on a regular surface the determinant of an exact sequence of rank r sheaves changes by a bounded twist
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma bounds the twist relating the determinants of the two middle terms of an exact sequence F to F' to the pushforward of a rank s bundle on an effective Cartier divisor of a regular surface: the two double duals of the r-th exterior powers are invertible and differ by a twist by k times the divisor with k between 0 and the minimum of s and r (statement lines 3276-3295). The counted proof has two layers: geometrically it uses functoriality of taking exterior powers and double duals to produce a canonical nonzero map and reduces the claim to a vanishing-order statement for a section of an invertible sheaf at the generic point of the divisor (proof lines 3297-3308); algebraically it translates that to the discrete valuation ring at that generic point and disposes of torsion, which does not change double duals, to reduce to free modules of rank r where the map becomes a determinant whose vanishing order is the length of the cokernel (proof lines 3309-3331). It is H2: the reductions are carried out in the counted span, and the deep input is the cited algebra statement on vanishing orders of determinants.
